To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have proposed a set of experiments to measure all polarised parton densities, and that we have shown that these experiments can be performed with the present and future generation of polarized beams and targets.

(i) the complete set of polarised parton densities can be measured in polarised muoproduction and polarisedpp collisions; and (ii) the polarised valence densities are measured first, then the polarised sea densities are determined through a combination of polarised muoprodution and polarised pp collisions, and finally the polarised gluon densities through polarised pp collisions.
the polarised valence densities are determined through the asymmetry in semi-inclusive hadronic production in muon-proton polarised collisions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the spin structure of the nucleon.
the study of polarised parton distributions in the proton.
the study of polarised hadron structure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the spin of the proton is not simply carried by the spin of the valence quarks.
the polarised gluon density is not known.
the spin dependent parton density functions of the proton are now known to a precision of 20% or better.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the complete set of polarised parton densities can be measured with a few percent accuracy.
the complete set of polarised parton densities can be determined from a few experiments.
the polarised gluon distribution can be determined from polarisedp-p data alone and that a measurement of polarised valence densities requires a polarised muon beam.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the complete set of polarised parton distributions is accessible through a set of polarized beam and target experiments.
a large set of polarised parton densities is accessible with present day polarised beam and polarised target facilities.
a complete set of spin-dependent parton densities can be determined from a few, well chosen experiments.
